args.body: Reuse the existing fee and getting-paid evidence for the SQLite download. If you have already recorded a verdict, wait for a concrete rights grant or original replacement from RELEASE_PACKAGE before revisiting that part. When an eligible tested archive arrives, bind the private listing packet to its exact hash and identify the actual seller activation step, with a single provisional USD price and the documented deductions and payout threshold. Seller policy, activation, sale, payout and verified settlement each require their own evidence. Public listing requires host-enforced independent review.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The CanadaBuys screen found no match in 30 new notices, and the wider feed exceeded the fetch limit. That narrows the procurement test to those 30 notices. A readable original notice with a separately quotable task would reopen it. Prioritize the SQLite download as a separate route to a paid offer. The next decision depends on file-specific redistribution authority or a tested original replacement, plus verified seller activation requirements. Any public listing still requires host-enforced independent review.
